sources.entry: Data Rescue - Comprehensive and professional data recovery tool for most cases.

summary.name: Data Rescue
summary.one_liner: Data Rescue is a commercial Mac (and Windows) data recovery application from Prosoft Engineering that scans drives to recover deleted, formatted, or otherwise lost files.
use_cases: Recovering files accidentally deleted or emptied from the Trash
Recovering data from a reformatted or corrupted drive
Recovering files from a Mac that will not boot using a recovery drive
Cloning a failing drive before scanning it
Recovering files from USB drives and SD cards
summary.what_it_does: Data Rescue scans internal and external drives (HDD, SSD, SD card, USB, Compact Flash and more) using Quick Scan for non-booting or unmounted drives and Deep Scan for emptied-trash or reformatted drives. Users can preview found files, often after a free demo scan, before purchasing and recovering them. Advanced tools include a read-only hex viewer, a clone function, a bootable Recovery Drive creator for scanning the startup disk, a secure erase tool, scan management (up to 15 stored scans), and virtual RAID 0/JBOD support. The page lists supported document, audio, and image formats and says it supports M1/M2 Macs.
notable: Free demo scan with file preview before purchase
Bootable Recovery Drive feature for recovering from the startup disk on macOS 10.13 and later
Virtual RAID support (RAID 0, JBOD) and a Number Sectors tool for guessing RAID drive order
caveats: Paid license required to recover files; trial recovery is limited to 1GB for new users only
All sales are final and the page states a strict no-refund policy
Cannot scan the startup drive directly on macOS 10.13 and later due to System Integrity Protection; a 32GB+ recovery drive is needed
A one-file license recovers only a single file
